title: Feature tour
text: default, print_rtree() ends displayed directory/file count. Set count_footer = FALSE compact output.
code: print_rtree(demo, max_depth = 2) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> |   `-- debug.log #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- helpers.R #> |-- README.md #> `-- test_cache #>  #> 5 directories, 4 files print_rtree(demo, max_depth = 1, count_footer = FALSE) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> |-- R/ #> |-- README.md #> `-- test_cache

title: Feature tour
text: ignore argument still supports exact basenames, ignore_type = "auto" also treats wildcard entries glob patterns. can opt regular expression matching control.
code: print_rtree(demo, ignore = c("*.log", "test_*"), max_depth = 2) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- helpers.R #> `-- README.md #>  #> 5 directories, 2 files print_rtree(demo, ignore = "^(README|test_)", ignore_type = "regex", max_depth = 1) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |-- empty/ #> |-- logs/ #> `-- R/ #>  #> 4 directories, 0 files

title: Feature tour
text: Use prune = TRUE hide directories displayable children ignores depth limits applied.
code: print_rtree(demo, ignore = "*.log", prune = TRUE) #> printtree-feature-tour/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |       `-- sales.csv #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- helpers.R #> |-- README.md #> `-- test_cache #>  #> 3 directories, 4 files

title: Feature tour
text: Use quiet = TRUE return_lines = TRUE want work tree programmatically.
code: lines <- print_rtree(demo, return_lines = TRUE, quiet = TRUE) head(lines, 4) #> [1] "printtree-feature-tour/" "|-- data/"               #> [3] "|   `-- raw/"            "|       `-- sales.csv"

title: Feature tour
text: write_tree() writes tree output text Markdown file. Parent directories created automatically default.
code: tree_md <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-feature-tour-output", "tree.md") write_tree(demo, tree_md, format = "md", title = "Feature Tour Tree") readLines(tree_md, n = 8) #> [1] "# Feature Tour Tree"     ""                        #> [3] "```"                     "printtree-feature-tour/" #> [5] "|-- data/"               "|   `-- raw/"            #> [7] "|       `-- sales.csv"   "|-- empty/"

title: Feature tour
text: target folder inside Git work tree, git = TRUE annotates changed paths simple status markers includes legend.
code: repo <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-feature-tour-git") if (dir.exists(repo)) unlink(repo, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE) dir.create(repo, recursive = TRUE)  system2("git", c("-C", repo, "init"), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE) system2("git", c("-C", repo, "config", "user.email", "test@example.com")) system2("git", c("-C", repo, "config", "user.name", "Test User"))  file.create(file.path(repo, "tracked.txt")) #> [1] TRUE system2("git", c("-C", repo, "add", "tracked.txt"), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE) system2("git", c("-C", repo, "commit", "-m", "initial"), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)  writeLines("changed", file.path(repo, "tracked.txt")) file.create(file.path(repo, "new.txt")) #> [1] TRUE  print_rtree(repo, git = TRUE) #> printtree-feature-tour-git/ M #> |-- new.txt ? #> `-- tracked.txt M #>  #> 0 directories, 2 files #> Git status: ? untracked, M modified, + staged print_rtree("path/to/repo", git = TRUE)

title: Printing directory trees with printtree
text: Print tree current working directory Print tree
code: tmp <- tempdir() demo <- file.path(tmp, "printtree-demo")  # Start fresh  if (dir.exists(demo)) unlink(demo, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)  dir.create(demo, recursive = TRUE) dir.create(file.path(demo, "R")) dir.create(file.path(demo, "data", "raw"), recursive = TRUE)  file.create(file.path(demo, "R", "hello.R")) #> [1] TRUE file.create(file.path(demo, "README.md")) #> [1] TRUE file.create(file.path(demo, ".Rhistory")) #> [1] TRUE print_rtree() #> vignettes/ #> |-- feature-tour.Rmd #> |-- printtree.Rmd #> |-- tree-dark.png #> |-- tree-white.png #> `-- tree.png #>  #> 0 directories, 5 files

title: Printing directory trees with printtree
text: project = “root”, printtree can walk upward provided path detect project root using simple markers. default includes: .Rproj files (RStudio / Posit projects) DESCRIPTION files (R package roots) example, mark demo package-like root creating DESCRIPTION file, print subdirectory: can customize detection using rootmarkers:
code: file.create(file.path(demo, "DESCRIPTION")) #> [1] TRUE subdir <- file.path(demo, "data", "raw") print_rtree(subdir, project = "root") #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- hello.R #> |-- DESCRIPTION #> `-- README.md #>  #> 3 directories, 3 files print_rtree(subdir, project = "root", root_markers = c(".Rproj", "DESCRIPTION", "_quarto.yml")) #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- data/ #> |   `-- raw/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- hello.R #> |-- DESCRIPTION #> `-- README.md #>  #> 3 directories, 3 files

title: printtree
text: printtree prints compact directory tree R projects folder. can optionally detect project roots associated common R workflows (e.g., RStudio projects via .Rproj files) print tree appropriate root directory. Trees can include count summaries, Git status annotations, pattern-based ignores, pruning empty directories, PNG snapshots, text Markdown exports. package IDE-agnostic: project metadata detected, simply prints directory tree specified folder.

title: printtree
code: library(printtree)  # Current working directory print_rtree()  # Explicit path print_rtree("~/Projects/myproj")  # Project name (searched in search_paths) print_rtree("myproj", search_paths = c("~/Projects", "~/Documents"))  # Limit depth print_rtree(max_depth = 2)  # Ignore by glob pattern print_rtree(ignore = c("*.log", "test_*"))  # Annotate files with Git status print_rtree(git = TRUE)  # Return lines without printing lines <- print_rtree(return_lines = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)  # Use the old compact output without a count footer print_rtree(count_footer = FALSE)  # Hide directories with no displayable children print_rtree(ignore = "*.log", prune = TRUE)  # Unicode tree (if your terminal supports it) print_rtree(format = "unicode")  # Save a PNG snapshot print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE)  # Dark background snapshot print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_bg = "black", snapshot_file = "tree-dark.png")  #or White background with dark text print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_bg = "white", snapshot_file = "tree-white.png")  # Save to a specific directory print_rtree(snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_path = "~/Pictures")  # Save a Markdown tree write_tree(".", "tree.md", format = "md", title = "Project Tree")

title: printtree
text: project = “root”, printtree can walk upward given path detect project root using simple markers: .Rproj files (RStudio / Posit projects) DESCRIPTION files (R package roots) behavior can customized using root_markers argument. project root detected, tree printed provided path.
code: # Detect R package root (DESCRIPTION) print_rtree(project = "root")  # Include Quarto projects print_rtree(project = "root",             root_markers = c(".Rproj", "DESCRIPTION", "_quarto.yml"))

title: printtree
text: Default output uses ASCII portability. Hidden files excluded unless show_hidden = TRUE. Windows, hidden file-system attributes also respected hidden files excluded.

what: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
text: Prints directory tree given path. Optionally, detects RStudio project (.Rproj) can print project root.

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
code: print_rtree(   path = NULL,   ignore = c("renv", ".git", ".Rproj.user", "__pycache__", ".DS_Store", "node_modules",     ".Rhistory"),   ignore_type = c("auto", "fixed", "glob", "regex"),   max_depth = NULL,   show_hidden = FALSE,   project = c("auto", "root", "none"),   search_paths = c(".", "..", "~/Documents", "~/Projects"),   root_markers = c(".Rproj", "DESCRIPTION"),   format = c("ascii", "unicode"),   return_lines = FALSE,   quiet = FALSE,   count_footer = TRUE,   git = FALSE,   git_legend = TRUE,   prune = FALSE,   snapshot = FALSE,   snapshot_file = "tree.png",   snapshot_width = 800,   snapshot_bg = c("white", "black"),   snapshot_path = "." )

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
text: path Character. Directory path, project name, .Rproj file. NULL, uses current directory. ignore Character vector. Basenames exclude (e.g., ".git", "renv"). ignore_type = "auto", entries containing wildcard characters treated glob patterns, values "*.log" "test_*" work. ignore_type One "auto", "fixed", "glob", "regex". Controls ignore matched basenames. max_depth Integer. Maximum depth traverse. NULL unlimited. show_hidden Logical (TRUE/FALSE). Whether include hidden files/directories (starting "."). project One "auto", "root", "none". "auto": use path -(upward search) "root": walk upward path find project root (via root_markers) use found "none": never attempt root detection; print tree path search_paths Character vector. Used path existing directory (treated project name). Paths searched order. root_markers Character vector. Markers used project = "root" detect root directory. Special value ".Rproj" means "file ending .Rproj". Common markers include "DESCRIPTION" (R package root) "_quarto.yml" (Quarto project root). format One "ascii" "unicode". "ascii" portable terminals. return_lines Logical. TRUE, invisibly return printed character vector lines. quiet Logical. TRUE, suppress console output. Useful return_lines = TRUE. count_footer Logical. TRUE, append summary like "3 directories, 12 files". git Logical. TRUE, annotate files directories porcelain git status markers path inside Git work tree. git_legend Logical. TRUE git = TRUE, append short legend explaining Git status markers. prune Logical. TRUE, omit directories displayable children. snapshot Logical. TRUE, gives visual snapshot tree. snapshot_file Text. Snapshot PNG name snapshot set TRUE. snapshot_width Integer. Default set 800. snapshot_bg Either white black snapshot background. white, tree text appears black vice. snapshot_path Character. snapshot_path provided, file saved .

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
text: Invisible NULL, character vector printed lines return_lines = TRUE.

title: Print an R Project or Directory Tree — print_rtree
code: # Create a small example directory tree demo <- file.path(tempdir(), "printtree-demo") if (dir.exists(demo)) unlink(demo, recursive = TRUE) dir.create(demo, recursive = TRUE) dir.create(file.path(demo, "R")) file.create(file.path(demo, "R", "hello.R")) #> [1] TRUE file.create(file.path(demo, "README.md")) #> [1] TRUE  # Print the tree print_rtree(demo) #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- hello.R #> `-- README.md #>  #> 1 directory, 2 files   # Limit depth print_rtree(demo, max_depth = 1) #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- R/ #> `-- README.md #>  #> 1 directory, 1 file   # Save a PNG snapshot to a temporary file png_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png") print_rtree(demo, snapshot = TRUE, snapshot_file = png_file) #> printtree-demo/ #> |-- R/ #> |   `-- hello.R #> `-- README.md #>  #> 1 directory, 2 files
